def calculate_min_T_for_set(S):
    """
    Calculates the minimum required T (T_S) such that there exists an assignment 
    (e', f, g, h) from a 4-element subset of S satisfying |e'f - gh| <= T_S * fh.
    T_S = min over all valid assignments (|e'f - gh| / fh).
    """
    S_list = list(S)
    min_T_for_set = float('inf')
    
    # Iterate over all subsets of size 4
    for subset_tuple in itertools.combinations(S_list, 4):
        subset = list(subset_tuple)
        
        # Iterate over all permutations (e', f, g, h) of the 4 elements
        for p in itertools.permutations(subset):
